author: snebucA
text:
Hello Oedipus.

Someone can correct me as I haven't yet done the homework but my understanding of CP is that price will spike upwards in a down move (lower lows) i.e clearing supply for a potential move back up, and spike downwards in an up move (higher highs) i.e. clearing demand for a potential move back down...

So in your diagram above your diagonal line would better placed above price for a downward compression.

Where you have asked "Is this cp?" - I would say no. It's price reacting to the demand level to the left. Whether it will hold is another question:)
